notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company building a customer support + knowledge product. Started with Redwood Hosted API two-week trial (Nov 27–Dec 11). Goal: move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost once traffic and token economics validated. — Sales signals: high intent, values latency SLAs, cost-aware. Likes Redwood routing/fallback for regional failover.

POC feedback (from dev + infra):
- Hosted API trial stable; end-to-end latency 95th pct: 220–320ms for short responses (<=50 gen tokens).
- Observed cold-cache spike on first request pattern (internal telemetry) — asking about warmup patterns / KV caching config.
- Prompt set parity issue: a small subset of prompts produced higher token usage in hosted vs their baseline (investigating tokenization differences).

Commercial / buying notes:
- Product lead wants 6-month Dedicated commit if capacity sizing matches forecast.
- Procurement/Legal: needs standard SOW + PCI-lite language; procurement timeline ~3–4 weeks.
- Pricing discussed at high level: mid-market reserved pricing + burst/overage model. They asked for example tier: 3 vGPU equiv steady + autoscale to 6 for bursts.

Technical preferences and constraints:
- Prefer latest open models from Redwood catalog (customeval for accuracy), fallback to smaller/quantized variants during heavy load.
- Must integrate with company SSO and KMS; audit logs for generated outputs retained 90 days.
- Region preference: primary NA, DR in eu-west.

Decision drivers:
- Latency SLO (p95 < 350ms for chat paths)
- Cost per 1M tokens (must be < their current infra unit cost)
- Ease of migration from Hosted -> Dedicated (same API surface + rollout controls)

Quote from CTO on call: "If we can get predictable latency at our QPS with a price that beats building ops, we greenlight Dedicated."

poc_technical_summary:
Traffic sample used during hosted trial: sustained ~6 QPS daytime, peaks to ~18 QPS during product campaigns. Typical request mix: 70% conversational support queries (<50 prompt tokens), 20% doc-search / reranking (prompts 80–250 tokens, embeddings for candidates), 10% long-form summarization (>250 tokens). Average prompt tokens = 42; average generated tokens = 96. Observed token ratio (input:output) ~1:2.

Engineering asks for Dedicated: 95th pct latency <350ms for chat flows at 10 QPS sustained, ability to autoscale to 40 QPS burst, and deterministic token-cost accounting (per-route). They want KV/prefix caching enabled and suggestions for batching for reranking flows.
traffic_forecast:
Conservative baseline (6-mo window): avg sustained QPS = 10; expected growth 15%/month. Peak bursting profile: daily marketing spikes up to 40 QPS for 2–3 hours. Concurrency estimate: 25–45 concurrent inflight requests depending on token length. Monthly token forecast (3mo average): ~150M tokens/month (prompt+gen). Token mix breakdown: short (<=50 gen tokens) = 70% -> avg 60 tokens; medium (51–200) = 20% -> avg 120 tokens; long (>200) = 10% -> avg 400 tokens.

Capacity sketch (SE note): steady Dedicated baseline = ~3 vGPU-equivalents (model/quantization dependent) to meet p95 targets at 10 QPS; autoscale headroom to 6 vGPU to handle 40 QPS bursts with <20% queueing. Recommended config: reserved pool sized for baseline + autoscale policy with warm standby.
